correctness.rationale: The exact all-length census follows from a bijection between every factor with at least two 1s and the first unique successive-marker gap plus its initial offset; the first marker pair contributes precisely one. All one-marker and zero words exist. The derivative sets are exactly the isolated orbit, the one-marker convergent family and zero; Mazurkiewicz-Sierpiński fixes the ordinal type. Uniformly bounded Riemann-sum errors prove the positive coefficient for fixed alpha; geometric gaps yield linear bounds. The shift ultrametric equates separated-set growth to factor growth, while uniform zero marker frequency forces every invariant Borel probability to be a delta at zero. verify.py independently reproduced all 1161 tested parameter/length pairs. No finite test substitutes for these infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The 2026 research establishes orbit-dense dynamics on a fixed rank-three countable compactum but only a qualitative conjugacy dichotomy. The present exact sparse-gap dynamics gives a continuum of quantitative orbit-complexity invariants while keeping ordinary entropy zero and the entire invariant probability simplex fixed at one atomic point. The explicit count constant explains the spectrum mechanism and can guide comparisons of measurable and topological dynamical complexity; the ordinal/dense-orbit/unique-measure conjunction is mathematically motivated, not an arbitrary slice.
